services.name: Event Rental
services.desc: The Gio Ponti-designed Martin Building and Daniel Libeskind-designed Hamilton Building at the Denver Art Museum feature the perfect locations to host your next event! In addition to wonderful architectural spaces, your guests can enjoy art from our broad collection of over 70,000 objects or access to the museum’s special exhibitions. The options for event spaces are ideal for a variety of uses-from corporate business meetings or intimate dinners to sumptuous galas and every special event in between, your guests will walk away with a memorable experience. services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Groups of 10 or more are welcome to request a docent-led tour of the museum’s collections and special exhibitions. Requests must be made at least three weeks in advance. Tours scheduled less than three weeks out will incur a rush fee of $100. Members receive a 10% discount on group tour packages booked on Mondays. Please note full payment is due at time of booking. If this is not possible for your group, payment must be made at least two weeks prior to your visit date. Adult and seniors of 10 or more people can request a guided docent-led or self-led group tour of the museum’s collections and special exhibitions. services.name: Creative Classes
services.desc: In this 1-day workshop, students will explore printmaking using accessible and non-toxic materials. Invented by artist Émilie Aizier in 2011, kitchen, or tin foil lithography relies on the relationship between oil and water used in stone and plate litho printing methods. Using kitchen lithography students will create reproductions of drawings in ink without a press and utilizing common household supplies like Coca-Cola, aluminum foil, vegetable oil, and a wooden spoon. No harsh chemicals are used!
